# Device history map user camera priority (2026-04-24 09:27Z)

_**User**_

Reported that when opening a device's history map, moving with the device and receiving a new position update causes the history map to zoom or pan. The requested behavior was that manual user interaction with the history map should take priority.

---

_**Agent**_

Changed `iPhone_DeviceHistoryMapView` so non-suppressed user pan/zoom changes are tracked and live history refreshes no longer automatically refit the map after the user has adjusted the camera.

Kept explicit timeline actions, such as quick range selection and playback focus, able to move the camera intentionally.

Documented the behavior in `documentation/device-history-map-user-camera-priority-2026-04-24.md` and updated `CHANGELOG.md` for version 3.1.7.

Verified the app still builds with:

```sh
xcodebuild -project miataru.xcodeproj -scheme miataru -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build
```
